answer: For a poll on a nebula mural at the vertex of a ridge trail, the server checks for a distinct $1 deposit locked to each ballot and this poll, rejecting missing or reused deposits. After counting, it refunds winning deposits and divides losing deposits equally among winning ballots; on a tie it refunds all deposits. Each extra ballot risks $1 if its side loses. Wealthy voters can dominate, and voting on both sides can recover some losses.
